'''Monarchs''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawns naturally in groups of 1 to 2 if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4, with a spawnweight of 10.
*Spawns in groups of 2 to 5 in the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
*Spawned by [[Heavy Bomber|Heavy Bombers]].

== ''Capabilities'' ==
Monarchs are highly mobile scout units that serve as late game infection spreaders and are primarily Melee combatants.
* Monarchs' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Monarchs can shoot web projectiles to immobilize their target with web blocks, creating [[Toxicant Webbing]] if they miss, which will disappear after some time.
* Monarchs can leap in the air, spawning 5 [[Buglin|Buglins]] during this attack.
* Monarchs can charge short distances, spawning 3 Buglins during this attack.
* Monarchs will regularly perform a short evasive dash.
* Monarchs can perform small leaps in liquids.
* Monarchs can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Like other [[Pure Parasites]], Monarchs can summon up to 3 [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them.
* Like other [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure Parasites]], Monarchs can use personal [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]] to teleport.
** Monarchs (along with the other Melee focused Pures) spawn [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrents]] significantly less than flying and grounded range Pures.
* Monarchs can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5, with a 20 ticks cooldown and 4 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=2|Breacher=BreacherMonarch.png|Texture=DeviantiveMonarch.png|TextureName=Deviantive|TextureDesc=inflicts double the damage but has half the HP.}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Monarchs, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death, Monarchs have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
